metadata.heading_title: Income of Other Persons, Included in Assessee's Total Income

heading.title: Income of Other Persons, Included in Assessee's Total Income

article.title: Revocable transfer of assets.
article.content:
61Revocable transfer of assets.

Section 61  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 243 of the Act
All income arising to any person by virtue of a revocable transfer of assets shall be chargeable to income-tax as the income of the transferor and shall be included in his total income.
